0.1.3.summary: Manual update checker, upstream falkTX sponsorship links, and version separation
changes: Introduced CLARA_VERSION_STRING decoupling Clara application releases from upstream engine versioning
Added manual 'Check for Updates...' option to the Help menu and toolbar menu with immediate feedback
Updated .github/FUNDING.yml including falkTX upstream sponsorship links alongside Clara maintainer
Modal ProjectLoadingDialog with animated marquee progress bar and real-time status updates
Modernized About screen: streamlined layout, removed legacy bitmap logos/fonts, and added repository & sponsor links
Patchbay camera autofocus: smooth 260ms pan-only navigation with InOutCubic easing curve
Fixed rack item delete confirmation modal across Delete/Backspace hotkeys and right-click context menu

installation.ubuntu: Download `.deb` and run: `sudo dpkg -i clara-ubuntu-*.deb && sudo apt-get install -f`
installation.fedora: Download `.rpm` and run: `sudo dnf install clara-*.rpm`
installation.nix: Run directly via Flake: `nix run github:acropolis914/Clara`

0.1.2.summary: Rack & Patchbay UI enhancements, animated camera pan, loading dialog, and modernized About dialog
changes: Modal ProjectLoadingDialog with animated marquee progress bar and real-time status updates
Modernized About screen: streamlined layout, removed legacy bitmap logos/fonts, and added repository & sponsor links
Patchbay camera autofocus: smooth 260ms pan-only navigation with InOutCubic easing curve
Configurable minimum node width in Canvas settings (Canvas/NodeMinWidth slider, 100-320px)
Fixed rack item delete confirmation modal across Delete/Backspace hotkeys and right-click context menu
Floating glassmorphism '+ Add Plugin' action button in rack view
Rack parameter dials: enforced uniform 68x54 grid dimensions and unclipped parameter labels

installation.arch: Install via AUR / PKGBUILD: `paru -S clara-git` (or extract `clara-archlinux-*.tar.zst` to `/usr`)
installation.ubuntu: Download `.deb` and run: `sudo dpkg -i clara-ubuntu-*.deb && sudo apt-get install -f`
installation.fedora: Download `.rpm` and run: `sudo dnf install clara-*.rpm`
installation.nix: Run directly via Flake: `nix run github:acropolis914/Clara`
